public.title: House Robber
public.description: Choose nonadjacent elements of values to maximize their sum. Return the maximum sum; choosing none is allowed. There are 0 to 1000 integers between 0 and 10000.
hints: At each value choose between skipping it and taking it after the prior nonadjacent prefix.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Two rolling optimum values represent prefixes ending one and two positions earlier. O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
